page.overview:
Who is Biosyn Operative?

After Dennis Nedry failed to show up at the East Dock with the Barbasol can full of dinosaur embryos, this operative was dispatched by Lewis Dodgson to meet Miles Chadwick and Nima Cruz at the North Dock with a boat. There, the operative would give the two their payment and deliver them off of the island.

However, by the time that Nima arrived at the dock with Gerry and Jessica Harding, there was no sign of the operative, just their boat. The three presumed that the operative had either been eaten by a dinosaur or killed by Billy Yoder who was also seeking to use the boat to escape and claim the money for selling the embryos to Biosyn. The Hardings and Nima used the boat to escape from the island and Jess found Nima's payment hidden in a locker on the boat.
